correctness.rationale: All vertex updates follow from exact neighbor counts; the even balanced two-cycles and other one-step cases are exhaustive. In odd order only two critical layers persist, with exact binomial probabilities a and b; a+b<1, two linear equations give exact hitting probabilities and E[T]. The derived maximum four follows monotonically and iid mixing is by conditioning. A separate SymPy linear solver checked 858 cases through n=40; not relied on for infinite theorem.
